# osgen duplicate-JSON-tag allowlist - DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.
# Regenerate by re-running `cmd/osgen` with `-update-tagshadow-allowlist`.
#
# Each line is a permitted tag shadow, keyed
# "OuterGoType/jsonTag/DeclaringGoType": OuterGoType declares jsonTag, and so
# does DeclaringGoType, which OuterGoType reaches through an embed. encoding/json
# resolves the duplicate in favor of the shallower field, so OuterGoType's
# declaration wins and DeclaringGoType's is never populated.
# The trailing comment is informational and ignored on load.
#
# A narrowing entry is the deliberate case: the winning field names a more
# specific type than the one it hides. An entry that erases a typed payload
# makes every field of the hidden type unreachable; an entry that widens the
# hidden field to a pointer makes a value the embed declares required optional
# on the winning declaration. An entry noting it makes a required field
# optional can omit the key entirely, whatever else it does to the type.
# Confirm any of these is intended before adding one.
